task.title: Response Compression
task.shortdesc: This section describes the guidelines related to response compression.

context.p: This section describes the guidelines related to response compression.
Responses over 1KB in size will automatically be compressed. Clients must be capable of decoding and decompressing compressed responses.
The Accept-Encoding header must be set to one of the following:

row.entry: Compression format using the Lempel-Ziv coding (LZ77) with a 32-bit CRC.
Compression format using the zlib structure, with the deflate compression algorithm.
Compression format using the Brotli algorithm.

context.p: If this header is not set, responses greater than 1KB will fail.
